ja: ひまなら君をキャンプに誘うのに、仕事なんだ。
en: If I were free, I'd invite you camping.
alternatives: I'd ask you camping if I were free.
If I weren't working, I'd invite you camping.
point: 現在の事実に反する仮定は If I were と過去形

ja: パーティーは何時に始まるの？
en: What time does the party start?
alternatives: When does the party start?
What time is the party?
point: 三人称単数の疑問文は does を使い start は原形

ja: 出張で送別会の誘いを断らなきゃいけなかった。
en: I had to turn down the farewell invitation.
alternatives: I had to decline the farewell party invitation.
I had to say no to the farewell party.
point: 「誘いを断る」は turn down。名詞は down の後ろでも可

ja: 妹の引っ越しを手伝う約束をしてたから、断ったんだ。
en: I'd promised to help my sister move, so I declined.
alternatives: I'd promised to help my sister move, so I passed.
I'd said I'd help my sister move, so I declined.
point: 先にした約束は I'd promised と過去完了で

ja: 妹、バーベキューは来るけど遅れるかもって。
en: My sister said she'd come but might be late.
alternatives: My sister told me she'd come but might be late.
My sister said she's coming but may be late.
point: 「言ってた」に合わせて will ではなく would にする

ja: みんなが来られるか聞いてくれる？
en: Could you ask if everyone can make it?
alternatives: Could you ask everyone whether they can come?
Can you find out if everyone can come?
point: 間接疑問は if everyone can と平叙文の語順

ja: カラオケ行けたらなあ。明日は早い便なんだ。
en: I wish I could come, but I fly early tomorrow.
alternatives: I wish I could go, but I fly early tomorrow.
I wish I could make it. My flight's early tomorrow.
point: 今の叶わない願いは I wish I could。I wish I can とは言わない

ja: 金曜に花火大会があるよ。行かない？
en: There are fireworks Friday. Want to go?
alternatives: Fireworks are on Friday. Want to come?
There's a fireworks show Friday. Interested?
point: 複数の fireworks には There are。誘いは Want to go? で軽く

ja: 行きたいけど、上司に出勤させられるんだ。
en: I'd love to, but my boss is making me work.
alternatives: I want to, but my boss is making me work.
I'd love to, but my boss has me working.
point: make me work の work は原形で、to は付けない

ja: 先月できたタイ料理の店、行った人みんな絶賛してる。
en: Everyone who's tried the new Thai place raves about it.
alternatives: Everyone who's eaten there raves about the new Thai place.
Everyone who's tried that new Thai spot loves it.
point: Everyone who's been は単数扱いなので動詞は raves

ja: 試合が終わったら、ご飯行こうよ。
en: Let's grab a bite when the game ends.
alternatives: Let's get something to eat after the game.
Let's go eat when the game's over.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形 ends

ja: バーベキューに飲み物持ってきてくれる？
en: Can you bring drinks to the barbecue?
alternatives: Could you bring some drinks to the barbecue?
Would you mind bringing drinks to the barbecue?
point: 「持ってきて」は bring。頼むときは Can you / Could you

ja: 佐藤さんちのバーベキュー、来る？
en: Are you coming to the Satos' barbecue?
alternatives: Are you going to the Satos' barbecue?
Will you come to the Satos' barbecue?
point: 決まった予定は進行形 Are you coming? で誘える

ja: 私たちと夕食でもどうかなと思ってたんですが。
en: I was wondering if you'd join us for dinner.
alternatives: I was wondering if you could join us for dinner.
I was hoping you'd join us for dinner.
point: 過去進行形 I was wondering if で控えめに誘う

ja: 今夜、一緒に夕食に行こうよ。
en: Let's go out for dinner tonight.
alternatives: Let's have dinner together tonight.
Let's go get dinner tonight.
point: 誘いは Let's＋動詞の原形で始める

ja: 遅れてもいいから、今夜ぜひ来てね。
en: Even if you're late, please come tonight.
alternatives: Please come tonight, even if you're late.
Do come tonight, even if you're late.
point: 「たとえ〜でも」は even if、中身は現在形

ja: ごめん、土曜日は忙しいんだ。
en: Sorry, I'm busy on Saturday.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm not free on Saturday.
Sorry, I have plans on Saturday.
point: busy は形容詞なので be 動詞が必要

ja: ずっと君をキャンプに誘おうと思ってた。
en: I've been meaning to invite you camping.
alternatives: I've been thinking of inviting you camping.
I've been wanting to invite you camping.
point: 「ずっと〜しようと思ってた」は I've been meaning to

ja: 彼女、ランチは断ったけど映画はもう OK した。
en: She turned down lunch, but she's accepted the movie.
alternatives: She declined lunch, but she's accepted the movie.
She declined lunch, but she's agreed to the movie.
point: 断ったのは過去形、「もう OK した」は現在完了 she's accepted

ja: 来週の土曜のほうがうちは都合いい。
en: Next Saturday is better for us.
alternatives: Next Saturday works better for us.
Next Saturday suits us better.
point: 日付を主語にして is better for us。We are better にしない

ja: パーティー、もう誘われた？
en: Have you been invited yet?
alternatives: Has anyone invited you yet?
Have you gotten an invite yet?
point: 「もう〜された？」は Have you been + 過去分詞 + yet

ja: 彼女、ライブ後にラーメンを提案したよ。
en: She suggested getting ramen after the show.
alternatives: She suggested we get ramen after the show.
She proposed getting ramen after the show.
point: suggest の後は to 不定詞ではなく -ing か「we + 動詞の原形」

ja: 君がもっと早く誘ってたら、彼女も来られたのに。
en: If you'd invited her sooner, she could've come.
alternatives: If you'd asked her earlier, she could've made it.
She could've come if you'd invited her sooner.
point: 過去の仮定は had invited と could have come

ja: 彼女の誕生日にケーキ持っていくね。
en: I'll bring a cake for her birthday.
alternatives: I'll bring a cake to her birthday.
I'll bring a birthday cake for her.
point: 丸ごとのケーキは数えられるので a cake

ja: 同僚のランチの誘いを断ったんだ。
en: I turned down a coworker's lunch invite.
alternatives: I declined a coworker's lunch invitation.
I turned down my coworker's lunch invitation.
point: 「誘いを断る」は decline か turn down。invite は名詞でも使える

ja: 土曜のバーベキュー、始める時間は君に任せるよ。
en: What time the barbecue starts is up to you.
alternatives: It's up to you what time we start.
I'll let you decide when the barbecue starts.
It's your call when the barbecue starts.
point: 「何時に始まるか」は what time the barbecue starts の語順

ja: あの誘い、断らなきゃ今ごろキャンプ場にいたのに。
en: If I hadn't turned it down, I'd be camping now.
alternatives: If I hadn't said no, I'd be camping now.
If I'd said yes, I'd be camping right now.
point: 過去の条件は hadn't turned down、今の結果は I'd be

ja: 彼女が知りたいのは、君が来られるかどうかだよ。
en: What she wants to know is whether you can come.
alternatives: She just wants to know if you can come.
What she's asking is whether you can make it.
point: 「〜なのは」は What で始め、かどうかは whether 節
